scope: AC01-AC12 evidence mapping for the 2026-10-29 local 10-second demonstration

criteria.basis: The historical Coding Agent changed executable code and its independent smoke acceptance returned AC01_AC02_OK.
The saved assertion failure, file-change events, and later successful acceptance show a real repair cycle.
The stage-a-ready commit 289150c predates the video business source files; its tree was checked read-only.
Coding Agent tool calls and source-change events record historical video-module creation and later DeepSeek migration and repair, with provider history kept distinct.
The new run inventories hashed media and records timed visual observations tied to actual source and movie frames.
DeepSeek v1 was rendered, fully decoded, visually reviewed, and validated pass at a measured 10000 ms.
DeepSeek v2 changes only title text and clip order in the frozen requirements, preserves the other inherited constraints, and validates pass at 10000 ms.

The first DeepSeek plan received real constraint errors; a separately recorded Coding Agent alias fix enabled a successful fresh attempt. The earlier FFmpeg encoder fault was explicitly injected and recovered, not presented as spontaneous.
Request and tool-call identifiers, command results, source hashes, and output hashes link the new run's stages and artifacts.
Both CLIs, pinned Python dependencies, configuration, and reproducible commands are documented; README identifies the completed DeepSeek run and its independent --run-dir acceptance command.

Raw per-run usage exists, but provider prices and billing for failed or external calls are unverified; the aggregate report predates the new video run, so total cost cannot be independently recomputed.
The project records a local implementation interval and a one-page status, but the formal exam start, full timing scope, and U01-U06 criteria remain unconfirmed; no complete exam pass is claimed.
